Chrome_WidgetWin_1 window named exactly 'Meet - <code>' (about 394x497), holding a Document
with an empty Name and URL about:blank, and inside it a mic button, a camera button and Leave.
Recorded per button: its Name and the class tokens that differ (mic on 'aLTxue jfzJEe', mic
muted 'Y3DJRd ZAsEvd', Leave 'RnWvU xCYCgd'). NOT recorded: the order of the tokens inside the
class string, the camera's tokens in PiP, and any other button the window may hold - the stem
and the camera row below are filled in from the tab dumps beside this file. Shape: the
MeetSurface the helper returns (meet-call-state.ts), not the tree shape of the other fixtures.
